# MAM-simple

On 2026-09-06, MAM-simple became a product tree in
[MAM-basics](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/tree/main/MAM-simple).
The MAM-simple data, documentation, example programs, and generated example
output are maintained there.

Read the product from the
[MAM-basics MAM-simple source tree](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/tree/main/MAM-simple)
or its [published MAM-simple pages](https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-simple/).

This repository remains only as a redirect host for legacy GitHub Pages URLs.
Its `gh-pages/index.html`, `gh-pages/versification-and-cantillation.html`, and
`gh-pages/404.html` are generated redirect stubs. Do not add product content to
this repository.
hosts.workflow_text:
name: Deploy GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: github-pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          # Serve only the gh-pages/ dir (matches the MAM-with-doc convention), so
          # generated pages get root-level URLs, e.g.
          # https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-simple/versification-and-cantillation.html
          path: gh-pages

      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5

# MAM-for-Sefaria

This repository is a GitHub Pages redirect host. On 2026-09-06, the
MAM-for-Sefaria product moved into MAM-basics:

* [MAM-for-Sefaria product data and documentation](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/tree/main/MAM-for-Sefaria)
* [Published documentation of the MAM-for-Sefaria encoding](https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-for-Sefaria/)

The product remains an extract of MAM (Miqra According to the Masorah) suitable
for Sefaria import. Its source is the
[MAM Google Sheet](https://purl.org/mam/google-sheet#gid=920165745).

The legacy published URL,
https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-for-Sefaria/, redirects to the published
MAM-basics documentation. The redirect preserves cited HTML pages; it does not
preserve raw-data URLs or establish that any Sefaria client fetches this
repository automatically.

The repository retains its history and the redirect because citations may still
refer to the legacy published URL.

# MAM-parsed has moved to MAM-basics

On 2026-09-06, the MAM-parsed product, documentation, and example program moved to [MAM-basics/MAM-parsed](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/tree/main/MAM-parsed). The published pages are at [MAM-basics/MAM-parsed](https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-parsed/).

This repository remains a Pages redirect host. Current JSON data and the historical versions needed for ordinary change-log generation are maintained in MAM-basics. See the [product README](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/blob/main/MAM-parsed/README.md) for usage and sparse-checkout instructions.

The Git history remains available for rare comparisons of arbitrary pre-migration revisions. That comparison mode requires read access to a sibling clone of this repository and explicit historical refs. Current data is no longer stored at this repository's HEAD.

# MAM-with-doc redirect host

On 2026-09-06, Phase 4 moved the MAM-with-doc product and its published Pages tree to
[`MAM-basics`](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics). The current edition is published at
https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-with-doc/.

This repository remains published only to redirect its frozen legacy HTML paths. Each old
`https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-with-doc/<path>` URL redirects to
`https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-with-doc/<path>`, preserving the path suffix.

New source, generated output, documentation, and release-difference work belongs in MAM-basics.
The repository history remains available here.

# MAM-OSIS redirect host

On 2026-09-10, the MAM-OSIS product moved to
[MAM-basics/MAM-OSIS](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/tree/main/MAM-OSIS).
The [product README](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/blob/main/MAM-OSIS/README.md)
contains the product documentation; the
[published documentation](https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-OSIS/)
is served by MAM-basics.

This repository remains a live GitHub Pages redirect host. The URL mapping is a
pure prefix rewrite from `https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-OSIS/<path>` to
`https://bdenckla.github.io/MAM-basics/MAM-OSIS/<path>`, preserving the path,
query, and fragment. The old URLs are cited in places Ben cannot reach, including
posts and sent email; there is no citation list.

The pre-evacuation history remains intact in this repository. The
[source issue tracker](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-OSIS/issues) remains
enabled and contains no issues as of 2026-09-10. File new product issues in
[MAM-basics](https://github.com/bdenckla/MAM-basics/issues).

Only the redirect-host files remain here. The `gh-pages/` stubs are generated;
do not hand-edit them. Regenerate them from MAM-basics with
`py/main_redirect_stubs.py build --repo MAM-OSIS --publish`.
